page.title: A free subscription tracker without ads or bank logins
page.lede: Coinio lets you track unlimited subscriptions up to 200 entries on the free hosted app at app.getcoinio.me—or unlimited on your own server—without connecting a bank account, watching ads or hitting a paywall.

compare.title: Coinio Free Cloud vs typical freemium apps
compare.lede: Most free subscription trackers cap you at five bills, ask for bank passwords or show card offers. Coinio is open source and gives you the full app.

steps.title: Start tracking in 60 seconds
steps.lede: No credit card, no server setup required.
steps.1: Open app.getcoinio.me/signup and sign in with email, passkey, Google or GitHub.
steps.2: Add your subscriptions from 161 built-in services or import a Wallos JSON file.
steps.3: Pick your currency and turn on renewal reminders before the next charge hits.
move.title: Outgrow the cloud? Take your data home
move.body: If you ever want to run Coinio on your own VPS, NAS or Raspberry Pi, download your Coinio JSON export in Settings › Account and import it into your self-hosted container with all payment history intact.
pfaq.title: Questions about the free version
pfaq.catch.q: What is the catch? Why is app.getcoinio.me free?
pfaq.catch.a: There is no catch, paid tier or ad network. Coinio is an MIT-licensed open-source project hosted as a goodwill service with reasonable per-account quotas so everyone gets fast performance.
pfaq.limits.q: What are the limits on the free hosted account?
pfaq.limits.a: Each account includes up to 200 subscriptions, 10 notification channels and 10 API keys—plenty for any personal setup.
pfaq.bank.q: Do I need to link my bank account?
pfaq.bank.a: No. You never share bank credentials. Adding a service takes seconds thanks to the 161-service catalog, and optional Firefly III sync works via your own API token.
pfaq.export.q: Can I export or delete my data?
pfaq.export.a: Yes, anytime. Export CSV or full Coinio JSON from Settings, or delete your account permanently in one step.
pfaq.selfhost.q: Can I switch from the hosted app to self-hosting later?
pfaq.selfhost.a: Yes. Coinio 0.4 imports Coinio’s own JSON export files including payment history, so moving to your own Docker container takes one upload.
final.pageLede: Open a free account online in 30 seconds, or paste the one-line Docker script on your server.
